description: Flipt feature flag evaluation metrics — per-flag latency, results, snapshots, streams, git backend, and server errors. Label names corrected to match actual /metrics output (flipt_flag, flipt_namespace, flipt_environment).

panels.description: Total evaluation request rate across all flags in the selected namespace.
panels.title: Eval Requests / sec

panels.description: Messages pushed over active streams per second.
panels.title: Stream Messages / sec

panels.description: Cumulative server errors. Non-zero means something went wrong.
panels.title: Server Errors Total

panels.description: Rate of git repository reads (flag config polling).
panels.title: Git Views / sec

panels.description: Per-flag evaluation request rate. Uses flipt_flag + flipt_namespace labels.
panels.title: Evaluation Request Rate

panels.description: Per-outcome breakdown. For boolean flags: value=true/false. For variant flags: match=true/false + segment.

targets.expr: sum by (flipt_environment, flipt_namespace, flipt_flag, flipt_value, flipt_reason) (label_replace(irate(flipt_evaluations_results_total{flipt_environment=~"$environment", flipt_namespace=~"$namespace", flipt_flag=~"$flag_key"}[$__rate_interval]),"flipt_reason", "$1", "flipt_reason", "(.+?)_EVALUATION_REASON"))

panels.title: Evaluation Results Rate by Outcome

panels.description: Heatmap of per-evaluation latency in milliseconds. Buckets: 0–10000ms.
panels.title: Evaluation Latency Heatmap

panels.description: Latency percentiles per flag. Unit is milliseconds (metric is _milliseconds not _seconds).
panels.title: Evaluation p50 / p95 / p99 Latency

targets.expr:
sum by (flipt_flag) (rate(flipt_evaluations_latency_milliseconds_sum{flipt_environment=~"$environment", flipt_namespace=~"$namespace", flipt_flag=~"$flag_key"}[$__rate_interval]))
/ sum by (flipt_flag) (rate(flipt_evaluations_latency_milliseconds_count{flipt_environment=~"$environment", flipt_namespace=~"$namespace", flipt_flag=~"$flag_key"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Note: many snapshot_latency values show _sum=0 meaning sub-millisecond latency rounds to 0 in the current data.
panels.title: Snapshot Latency p50 / p99

panels.description: Gauge — currently open streaming connections per namespace. High and stable = healthy long-lived streams.
panels.title: Active Streams over Time

panels.description: New stream connections established per second.
panels.title: Stream Request Rate

panels.description: Messages (flag state pushes) sent to connected stream clients per second.
panels.title: Stream Messages / sec

panels.description: Latency of stream setup (time until first message). Most connections are sub-ms (le=0 bucket dominates).
panels.title: Stream Setup Latency Heatmap

panels.description: Rate of git repository reads (fetches from remote for flag config). Driven by polling interval.
panels.title: Git View Rate

panels.description: Latency of git reads from remote. Your observed avg is ~426ms/16 reads ≈ 26ms avg. Watch p99 for network issues to git remote.
panels.title: Git View Latency p50 / p99

panels.description: Total server errors rate. You currently have 11 cumulative errors. Use rate() to see if new errors are occurring.
panels.title: Server Errors / sec

title: Flipt — Flag Evaluations
